caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, pattern equal to form, tapestry space, a gathering of twenty-one birds of many kinds, cranes, a phoenix, parrots and ducks, with two horned rams and a hunter bearing a long spear, set among mountains and a pond patterned with water-lilies, peacock blue, malachite green, ochre, gold
notes_zh: 《群鸟会》绘画核心区（已裁纯图案衬托边）。21只杂色鸟（鹤/公鸡/鹰/燕/雁/凤凰/鹦鹉/喜鹊/夜莺/鸭或鸳鸯）+两只有角公羊+一持长枪猎人；山石、池水、睡莲纹。色：金黄/孔雀蓝/深浅绿/赭石。主题 nature。
